attchmntText: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board meeting occurred on 14th November 2026. Statutory auditors Harish Khandelwal and Co issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the company reported a loss after tax of 64.61 lakh rupees compared to a profit of 15.69 lakh rupees in the previous year. Total income for the half year was 1919.88 lakh rupees. Profit before tax was a loss of 57.55 lakh rupees. Earnings per share was negative 0.60 rupees. Total assets stood at 4012.30 lakh rupees as of 30th September 2026. Cash generated from operations was 129.53 lakh rupees. The company has one reportable business segment related to telecom and EV installation activities.

attchmntText: Uniinfo Telecom Services Limited has informed the Exchange with copy of minutes of  Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026
